name: Binghan He
school: University of Texas at San Antonio
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: A recent Assistant Professor with a current graduate lab and an AI-relevant assistive-control agenda. The verified learned physical experiment is older, from his UT Austin doctoral period, so current UTSA apparatus and new learning experiments remain separate unknowns.

physicalEvidence.summary: Full ACC 2020 methods train a subject-specific random forest on EMG, stretch, position and velocity signals. Its online stiffness estimate changes compliance-shaping gains on an actual Apptronik P0 elbow exoskeleton, with physical stability and bandwidth tests. The study uses one participant, at UT Austin; it is not evidence of current UTSA hardware or cross-person generalization. The later MRI actuator work alone does not establish neural control.

shortVisit.summary: The live ISABEL joining page advertises one full-time Spring/Fall 2027 PhD position and explicitly lists safe learning-based control, deep learning and reinforcement learning. It does not invite external master’s visitors. Current local MS/PhD students and undergraduate interns are evidence of mentoring, not a Summer 2027 outside-master offer.

scoreReasons.physical: Detailed real older doctoral-period experiment, capped at 20; current UTSA execution not established.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: The current 2027 PhD vacancy is not a visiting-master route.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current recruitment and active group verified, but the full executed learning anchor is 2020; no maximum freshness from a new title.

name: Zhu Wang
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science; MIRAI Lab Director
fitReason: Explicit spatial-AI research backup under the recent-AP priority. Full generative-terrain methods establish more than generic HCI, and the current lab separately recruits research interns; robot execution remains unverified.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full VRST 2024 study uses Pix2Pix conditional GANs trained on satellite-derived terrain height maps, integrated with Quest 3 hand sketches to produce editable virtual terrain. Eight participants evaluated usability without a baseline. This is executed XR/spatial-AI software, not learned robot actuation. Separate tabletop robot and shape-changing-interface titles are not used as proof that the same learned method controls physical robots.

shortVisit.summary: The current MIRAI lab explicitly recruits research interns each year. The PI’s university homepage separately welcomes undergraduate and master’s research inquiries. External-institution eligibility, an eight-week summer duration, payment and remote participation are not specified; this is a generic inquiry route rather than a confirmed Summer 2027 slot.

scoreReasons.fit: Verified generative spatial interaction method; less direct robot-learning fit.
scoreReasons.physical: XR and terrain generation do not demonstrate learned robot execution.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Explicit current generic research-intern invitation earns inquiry-level8; separate master interest does not independently establish outside-master eligibility, duration or acceptance.
scoreReasons.freshness: Full 2024 technical anchor and 2025 group/co-advising evidence; no dated 2026 research method or summer cycle established.
